hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.py) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; [ -f pyproject.toml ] || exit 0; uv run --quiet ruff format --quiet "$f" 1>&2 && uv run --quiet ruff check --fix --extend-ignore F401 --quiet "$f" 1>&2 || exit 2
